name: Apotris

assets.needs: Nothing. Apotris is free original homebrew; the APK carries all music, sound and shaders.
assets.location: /sdcard/Documents/Apotris/assets (extracted from the APK on first run; extracted.txt marks it)
assets.notes: Not a recomp of a commercial game: an original block-stacking game written for the GBA that ships native PC/Android builds. The GBA ROM build can also sit in Cocoon's library as a separate game.

settings.summary: All options (handling DAS/ARR, skins, ghost piece, shaders such as crt-lottes/zfast_lcd, audio) are stored inside the 32 KB binary save Apotris.sav, the same savefile struct as the GBA build. No text config, so no adapter. preferences.txt holds only '1' plus a newline (meaning not checked).

controls: SDL2 game controller (gamecontrollerdb). Remapping in the in-game Controls menu, stored in Apotris.sav. No touch overlay in the Java layer (plain SDLActivity).
display: Single screen (top). Plain SDLActivity with no secondary-display code.
saves: /sdcard/Documents/Apotris/Apotris.sav (32 KB; settings and high scores together). storage_path.txt in /data/data/com.akouzoukos.apotris/files points the game at /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Apotris/.
notes: The official release zip Apotris-v4.2.0Android.zip holds Apotris.apk (15,116,136 bytes); the checked APK matched it in size. A separate unofficial port exists (github.com/SanGraphic/Apotris-Android, package not checked); this entry covers the official build.
verified: On device: dumpsys version/install date, storage_path.txt, /sdcard/Documents/Apotris listing, preferences.txt contents, APK contents. From web: GitHub repo akouzoukos/apotris exists (no releases or licence listed there). Original release year not confirmed. Save format not decoded.
